# v3 phase 6 (generated by tools/build_emirate_world.py)
on_actions = {
	# ROOT is the winner, FROM is annexed. The Second Ikhwan Revolt in Najd ends.
	on_civil_war_end = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = NSR_najd_ikhwan }
				set_global_flag = NSR_najd_revolt_won
				if = {
					limit = { country_exists = NSR }
					NSR = { country_event = { id = nsr_emirate.58 days = 1 } }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = NSR_najd_ikhwan } }
				set_global_flag = NSR_najd_revolt_crushed
				if = {
					limit = { country_exists = NSR }
					NSR = { country_event = { id = nsr_emirate.59 days = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly_NSR = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = NSR_fitna_won
					NOT = { has_country_flag = NSR_cordoba_taken }
					789 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT }
				}
				set_country_flag = NSR_cordoba_taken
				country_event = { id = nsr_emirate.51 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
